values.note: $36 a night for a 30 A site with water (35 RV sites, plus the full-hookup ADA 2); $42 for the 14 full-hookup 50 A sites. Same Tuesday 2026-11-10, Saturday 2026-11-14 and Saturday 2027-06-19 ($252 / $294 a week). Tent-only sites 53-64 are $36; the backcountry site $12. The park page: 'Overnight guests pay daily ParkPass fee only once per vehicle during their stay ... Parking is not included with reservation.'

values.note: 67 electric sites on the booking site, 5 of them host sites, leaving 62 for the public (the park page says 67). 50 take a 23-ft rig (43 at 50 ft, 7 at 35 ft); the 12 tent-only sites 53-64 are 10 ft. Mostly pull-throughs. One backcountry site and two pioneer camps besides.

summary: Park page + map + ReserveAmerica catalog: $36 (30 A + water) / $42 (14 full-hookup 50 A sites), unchanged Nov 2026 / Jun 2027, weekday and Saturday; 62 public sites (67 less 5 host), 50 fit 23 ft (max 50, mostly pull-throughs), 12 tent-only; showers, laundry, dump on the map. Pin is on Savage Island among the sites (no flag). AWH's 'not waterfront' kept: the loops sit inside the island's tree line, the island fringed by Redbird Creek salt marsh rather than open water. Only the RV Life rating line dropped from the note.
